blocks.text: This is an internal test book. It exists only to validate the full reader experience: page navigation, language switching, display and text size adjustment, and content protection.
No real CorpoPleno content is being published here — this book must never be sold to a real customer.
Use the arrows at the bottom of the reader to move forward and back. On mobile, tap the arrows; on a computer, you can also use the keyboard arrows.

blocks.alt: CorpoPleno logo in purple and pink tones
blocks.caption: CorpoPleno visual identity, used here as an example of an image embedded in a page.

blocks.text: The reader automatically adapts to your screen size. If you prefer, use the "Adjust reading" icon to manually choose Computer/TV, Tablet, or Phone, and to increase or decrease the text size.
Every time you turn the page, your progress is saved automatically. When you reopen this book, you'll return exactly where you left off.
Right now, progress is saved only in this browser — once real customer accounts exist, it will follow you across devices.
You've reached the last page of this test book. In a real book, this is where references, acknowledgments, or an invitation to the next title could appear.
